```{r getData}
target_colours_new<-c(
  "SARS-CoV-2" = "#6699CC",
  "RSV" = "#DDAA33",
  "Influenza A" = "#EE99AA",
  "Influenza B" = "#994455",
  "Influenza (A+B)" = "#CC6677"
)

#Fig 1a and 1b - SARI data with school abundance on same x-axis scale
Plotdata <- read.csv("./PCRanalyses/Plotdata.csv")

### Get SARI data

SARIdata<-read_delim("./PCRanalyses/SARI_Wohnregion_Patient_v202602.csv",
                     delim=";",comment="#")

plot_SARI <- SARIdata %>%
  filter(
    JAHR == 2024,
    KW >= 7, KW <= 18,
    WOHNORT == "W"
  ) %>%
  group_by(JAHR, KW) %>%
  summarise(
    SC2 = sum(COVID),
    RSV = sum(RSV),
    Flu = sum(INFLUENZA)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(JAHR:KW),
    names_to = "virus",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(KW) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = count / sum(count),
    virus = case_when(
      virus == "Flu" ~ "Influenza (A+B)",
      virus == "SC2" ~ "SARS-CoV-2",
      T ~ virus
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = KW, y = prop, fill = virus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = 0),
    limits = c(6.5, 18.5),
    breaks = breaks_width(1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colours_new) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  labs(
    x = "Sampling week",
    y = "Relative abundance",
    fill = "Target"
  )

pcrdata <- read_csv("./PCRanalyses/PCRdataMod.csv") %>%
  mutate(KW = isoweek(date)) %>%
  filter(!Target.Name %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Streptococcus pneumoniae")) %>%
  mutate(
    school_masked = case_when(
      school == "G" ~ "A",
      school == "K" ~ "B",
      school == "M" ~ "C",
      school == "H" ~ "D",
      school == "R" ~ "E",
      school == "W" ~ "F"
    ),
    weekday = wday(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(Target.Name %in% c("SARS-CoV-2", "RSV", "Influenza A", "Influenza B")) %>%
  group_by(school_masked, Target.Name, KW) %>%
  mutate(kw_sample = ifelse(weekday == min(weekday), KW - 0.2375, KW + 0.2375)) %>% # to account for multiple samples in the same KW
  group_by(school_masked, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total_conc = sum(Conc.cp.µl.undiluted.sample.mean, na.rm = T),
    relative_abundance = Conc.cp.µl.undiluted.sample.mean / total_conc,
    plot_row = case_when(
      school_masked %in% c("A", "D") ~ 1,
      school_masked %in% c("B", "E") ~ 2,
      school_masked %in% c("C", "F") ~ 3
    ),
    plot_col = ifelse(school_masked %in% c("A", "B", "C"), 1, 2)
  ) %>%
  group_by(school_masked) %>%
  mutate(
    max_conc = max(total_conc, na.rm = T),
    relative_conc = total_conc / max_conc
  )

plot_sch_pcr <- lapply(pcrdata$school_masked %>% unique() %>% str_sort(), function(x) {
  sch_data <- pcrdata %>%
    filter(school_masked == x) %>%
    mutate(Target.Name = factor(Target.Name, levels = str_sort(names(target_colours_new))))

  sch_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = kw_sample, y = relative_abundance, fill = Target.Name)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.425, show.legend = T) +
    geom_line(
      aes(
        y = relative_conc,
        group = school_masked,
        color = "Total pathogen\nabundance"
      )
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(y = relative_conc), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_text(
      data = . %>% filter(max_conc == total_conc) %>% slice_head(n = 1),
      aes(y = 1.08, label = round(total_conc, 2)),
      size = 1.75
    ) +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 1) {
        scale_x_continuous(
          expand = expansion(mult = 0),
          limits = c(6.5, 11),
          breaks = breaks_width(1)
        )
      }
    } +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 2) {
        scale_x_continuous(
          expand = expansion(mult = 0),
          limits = c(11, 18.5),
          breaks = breaks_width(1)
        )
      }
    } +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 1) {
        scale_y_continuous(
          name = "Relative pathogen abundance",
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0)),
          limits = c(-0.05, 1.13),
          breaks = breaks_width(0.5)
        )
      }
    } +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 2) {
        scale_y_continuous(
          name = "Relative pathogen abundance",
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0)),
          limits = c(-0.05, 1.13),
          breaks = breaks_width(0.5),
          sec.axis = dup_axis(name = "Total abundance relative to school maximum")
        )
      }
    } +
    scale_fill_manual(values = target_colours_new, drop = F) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("black")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), ) +
    labs(
      x = "Sampling week",
      y = "Relative abundance",
      fill = "Target",
      colour = "",
      subtitle = paste("School", x)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = NA)),
      colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
    ) +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 1) theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
    } +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_col) == 2) theme(axis.text.y.left = element_blank(), axis.title.y.left = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
    } +
    {
      if (unique(sch_data$plot_row) < 3) theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(b = 6))
    }
}) %>%
  wrap_plots(nrow = 3, ncol = 2, byrow = F, guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect", widths = c(11 - 6.5, 18.5 - 11))

{ plot_SARI + theme(legend.position = "none") } / 
  plot_sch_pcr +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 3)) &
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.3, units = "cm"))

ggsave("./Figures/2026-11_SARI_pcr_plot.png",width=6.5,height=4,dpi=300)
```

```{r}
# CO2 - simulated sinoidal curve (day night cycles)
# duration - time above 1400ppm - how many 5 minute intervals recorded above threshold x5
# exposure - auc 36hr period before upload time

# sinusoidal signal equation: y = A * sin(2 * pi * f * t + phi)
# set parameters
amplitude <- 1500 / 2 # Height of the wave
frequency <- 1 / 24 # Cycles per hour (Hz)
phase <- 4 * pi / 5 # Horizontal shift (radians)
sample_rate <- 5 # Points per hour
duration <- 72 # Total time in hours

set.seed(46745) # using runif to add noise

df_co2 <- data.frame(time = seq(0, duration, by = 1 / sample_rate)) %>%
  mutate(
    y = sin(2 * pi * frequency * time + phase)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    y_noise = y * amplitude + 400 + amplitude * runif(1, 0.9, 1.1),
    y_noise_1400 = ifelse(y_noise > 1400, 1400, y_noise),
    y_noise_36hr = ifelse((time >= (sampling_time - 36)) & (time <= sampling_time), y_noise, NA),
    y_noise_sampling = ifelse((time >= (sampling_time - 25)) & (time <= (sampling_time - 1)), y_noise, NA),
    time_adj = time - sampling_time
  )

sampling_time <- 60
exposure_length <- 36

df_co2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_adj, y = y_noise)) +
  geom_area(aes(fill = "duration")) +
  geom_area(aes(y = y_noise_1400), fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_area(data = . %>% filter(time_adj >= -exposure_length & time_adj <= 0), aes(y = y_noise_1400), fill = "white") +
  geom_area(aes(y = y_noise_sampling), fill = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_area(aes(y = y_noise_36hr, fill = "exposure"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1400, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkgrey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  annotate(geom = "text", y = 1420, x = -55, label = "1400ppm", vjust = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = 0),
    breaks = c(0, -36, -13), labels = c("Data\nupload", "36 hours prior\nto sample", "24 hour sample\ncollection")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 0), breaks = scales::breaks_width(400)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("duration" = "#66ddee", "exposure" = "#ee6677")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hours)",
    y = "CO~2~ (ppm)",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("./Figures/2026-11_CO2_metrics_plot.png",width=6,height=4,dpi=300)


```
